sum_insured_options: Global SI: USD 5L, 7.5L or 10L; India Cover (optional): INR 4.5 Cr, 6.5 Cr or Unlimited

room_rent.note: India Cover: actuals, any room category. Global Cover: no room sub-limit stated.

icu.note: ICU charges covered within SI; no separate sub-limit mentioned.

copayment.note: 20% co-pay on assessed claim if insured (or eldest in floater) is aged 61+ at first policy inception. Optional waiver available.

sub_limits.display: Gene Therapy sub-limited; most covers at SI
sub_limits.note: Gene Therapy: 50% of Global SI or USD 5L (lower), lifetime 100% of SI. Royal+ covers ALL illnesses globally including Specified Illnesses.

initial_waiting.note: Global Cover: 90-day initial waiting period. India Cover: 30-day initial waiting period. Waived after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12 mo via optional add-on)
ped_waiting.note: Default PED waiting is 36 months. Optional add-on (3.3.3) can reduce to 24 or 12 months at extra premium.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions. Joint replacement: 36 months.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of India Base SI
cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of India Base SI added per claim-free year; 25% reduced per claim year. Max 100%. Not applicable for Unlimited India Base SI option.

restoration.note: Unlimited Reinstatement of India Base SI after each claim, for both related and unrelated illness/injury. Applicable to India Cover only. Not available on Unlimited SI.

pre_hosp.note: Global Cover: from date of arrival in city of treatment up to 15 days. India Cover: 90 days.

post_hosp.note: Global Cover: 30 days post-discharge. India Cover: 180 days.

day_care.display: All day-care (India Cover); Pre/post-operative day care (Global)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered within SI under India Cover. Certain diseases excluded.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered under India Cover. Not applicable to Global Cover.

organ_donor.note: Donor expenses covered under both Global and India Cover within respective SIs.

ambulance.note: India Cover: domestic road and air ambulance within SI. Global Cover: ambulance included in in-patient treatment benefit within Global SI.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc. covered within India Base SI.

consumables.note: Consumables listed in Annexure A-List I covered under India Cover in-patient/day care.

global_cover.note: Royal+ covers ALL illnesses abroad (not just Specified Illnesses). Highest SI options. Planned treatment only; cashless via empanelled providers.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, infertility/IVF, hazardous sports (professional), external congenital anomaly, sleep apnea, hormone therapy, peritoneal dialysis, treatment in India (Global Cover)
optional_riders: Waiver of Co-Payment (age 61+), Voluntary Co-Payment (10%/20% discount), Reduced PED waiting (12 or 24 months), India Cover (optional add-on)
